scope_review.relation_rationale: Primary composite matches the requested event set and 24-month time point, compares randomized clopidogrel and aspirin assignment, and is analyzed by intention to treat; incomplete event-free follow-up is censored.

target.outcome: Composite of all-cause death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, readmission for acute coronary syndrome, and BARC type 3 or greater bleeding
target.measurement: Composite of all-cause death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, readmission due to acute coronary syndrome, and BARC type 3 or greater bleeding

reported_endpoint.name: Primary composite endpoint†
reported_endpoint.definition: Composite of all-cause death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, readmission due to ACS, and major bleeding events (BARC type ≥3).

scope_review.reported_analysis_population: All 5438 randomized patients in the ITT population; endpoint ascertainment was complete in 5338 (98.2%).
scope_review.instruction: Compare outcome definition, time window, estimand and population against the selected source passages. Null reported timing/estimand means not separately represented, not absent from the source. Known target fields, a matching endpoint label, or bound numbers do not prove exactness. Keep material conflict/uncertainty in clarity and rationale; choose a supported non-exact relation or another candidate when exact scope is not established. Do not redefine the target.
